facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹2.29 lakh cr, +18% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹38,472 cr, −14% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹60,878 cr (+17% YoY), PAT ₹10,710 cr (+24% YoY), operating margin 57.4%.
Revenue has compounded at 8% over 10 years, 16% over 5 and 15% over 3.
Profit has compounded faster than revenue over 3 years (45% vs 15%): operating leverage is working.
Operating margin is steady at 57.4% (56.7% a year ago).
Annual operating margin has ranged from 49% to 55% over five years; the latest year (55%) sits at the top of that range.
Borrowings are ₹1.99 lakh cr against equity of ₹1.58 lakh cr: debt/equity 1.26× (was 2.91× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 5.7× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle is 14 days, little changed from 10 in Mar 2023.
Promoters hold 50.1%, −0.2 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹4.20 lakh cr of operating cash came from ₹4.08 lakh cr of operating profit: 103% conversion; against PAT of ₹1.00 lakh cr that is 4.2×.
Free cash flow was negative in 0 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹2.43 lakh cr, latest year ₹76,683 cr.
Capex ran at 22% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹45,547 cr (averaged 23% over the three years before).

claims.claim: The AI traffic on our networks is very small and it will grow.
claims.quote: Look, today, the AI traffic on our networks is very, very small and it will grow.

claims.claim: The intervention of Rs 299 pack is more of experimentation on our own base.
claims.quote: I would believe that, aside saying, the intervention of Rs 299 pack is more of experimentation on our own base, keep moving ARPU up

claims.claim: The radio capex has moderated and that will continue.
claims.quote: the radio capex has kind of moderated, and that will continue because a lot of the build-out has already happened.

claims.claim: Consolidated Net debt to EBITDAaL improved to about 0.70.
claims.quote: Our consolidated Net debt to EBITDAaL improved to about 0.70, with India excluding passive now below 1, at 0.96.

claims.claim: The company's market share in data centers is currently 12%.
claims.quote: We believe that our market share here at about 12% is clearly low for the large heft and size that we have as a Company.

claims.claim: Airtel's Africa operations generate an annualized EBITDA of over Rs.35,000 Crores.
claims.quote: Airtel's Africa operations today, generate an annualized EBITDA of over Rs.35,000 Crores and I truly believe this is a very, very rare achievement for an Indian based company.

claims.claim: Airtel Money has achieved a Q1 revenue of over $400 million.
claims.quote: Airtel Money has now achieved meaningful scale with a Q1 revenue of over $400 million growing at 26% year-on-year in constant currency terms

claims.claim: Airtel Payments Bank has a monthly transacting user base of around 120 million.
claims.quote: Airtel Payments bank, which is another engine of our financial services portfolio, continues to deliver strong performance. We ended Q1 with a monthly transacting user base of around 120 million.

claims.claim: The current price architecture in India is broken due to unlimited data plans capping revenue.
claims.quote: Fundamentally, my belief is that the price architecture in this country is broken. You contrast Indian pricing with African pricing. For every GB that is consumed, there is a little bit of revenue that you get.

claims.claim: Fixed wireless access (FWA) has become significantly more expensive due to rising chipset and memory prices.
claims.quote: The fixed wireless access has now become very much more expensive. So we have pivoted the whole company back to a dramatic obsession on fiber.

claims.claim: Airtel has gained revenue market share in mobility to reach a lifetime high.
claims.quote: Mobility sustained revenue market share gains to reach a lifetime high share.

claims.claim: Net debt to EBITDAaL ratio is 1.1.
claims.quote: Net debt to EBITDAaL now stands at 1.1.

claims.claim: The company currently holds about 12% market share in the overall Data Center market.
claims.quote: It is a very fragmented market, and we are at about 12% market share on the overall Data Center market.

claims.claim: The company is seeing strong traction in its cloud business with 16 signed deals and over 300 ongoing conversations.
claims.quote: Within a short span of time, we have signed over 16 deals with over 300 ongoing conversations with customers across sectors with a focus on BFSI and manufacturing.

claims.claim: The company's site running costs have declined by over 6% in the last four years despite accelerated rollouts.
claims.quote: A prime example of this is our site running cost, which have declined by over 6% in last four years despite accelerated rollouts and addition of new technology layers.

claims.claim: The company is not seeing a need for differential 5G pricing, preferring a pricing architecture where customers pay more for more data.
claims.quote: I think that pricing repair and architecture discussion that we have had is still playing out, and I think we need to do a lot more on that side for getting ARPU growth.

claims.claim: Airtel has shown consistent gains in revenue market share over the last few years.
claims.quote: in the last few years, we have shown consistent gains in revenue market share, our track record, pretty much, speaks for itself on the way that our competitiveness has grown.

claims.claim: India revenues, excluding Indus, came in at Rs.34,900 Crores and the EBITDAaL margin excluding the passive infra side came in at 51.5%.
claims.quote: India revenues, excluding Indus, came in at Rs.34,900 Crores and the EBITDAaL margin excluding the passive infra side came in at 51.5%.

claims.claim: The industry is expected to grow to about 100 million connected homes over the medium term.
claims.quote: As I mentioned, we see the industry growing to about 100 million over the medium term, from currently over 50 million connected homes.

claims.claim: Airtel provides 7,60,000 jobs, making it one of the largest employment generators in India.
claims.quote: That means we provide 7,60,000 jobs, making us one of the largest employment generators in India.

claims.claim: We have a market share of almost 60% in IoT and we are clearly winning the segment.
claims.quote: Here, we have a market share of almost 60% and we are clearly winning the segment

claims.claim: Airtel Cloud is clearly the largest Cloud instance for an individual company in this country.
claims.quote: I can also tell you that as a Cloud for an individual company in this country, this is clearly the largest Cloud instance.

claims.claim: The Airtel Payments Bank annualized revenue run rate is now over 3,100 Crores, growing over 27% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Annualized revenue run rate is now over 3,100 Crores, growing over 27% year-on-year.

claims.claim: Airtel Payments Bank deposits remain strong at about 3,750 Crores, growing 29% year-on-year.
claims.quote: Deposits remain strong at about 3,750 Crores, growing 29% year-on-year.
